data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.name: fish-speech
data_tooling.summary: Fish Speech 是一个开源文本转语音系统，通过生成自然流畅的语音，解决了高质量语音合成工具的可及性问题。其技术核心在于结合 VQ-VAE 的离散语音表示与基于 Transformer 的语言建模，实现了高效且富有表现力的语音生成。用户可通过微调特定数据集来创建个性化语音、集成到应用程序中，或探索多语言语音合成实验，为语音交互应用提供灵活的技术基础。
data_tooling.summary_en: Fish Speech is an open-source text-to-speech system that generates natural-sounding speech from text, addressing the need for accessible high-quality voice synthesis. It combines VQ-VAE for discrete speech representation with transformer-based language modeling, enabling efficient and expressive speech generation. Developers can use it to create custom voices, integrate into applications, or experiment with multilingual TTS by fine-tuning on specific datasets.

agents_workflows.name: AstrBot
agents_workflows.summary: AstrBot是一个开源的多平台智能聊天机器人框架，它让AI助手能够同时在Discord、Telegram等多种即时通讯工具中运行。其核心设计采用模块化架构，将平台适配器、大语言模型后端和插件系统清晰分离，开发者可以像搭积木一样组合不同组件。通过Docker部署后，你可以创建自定义的AI代理，让它在群聊中自动回复消息、通过插件执行具体任务，并根据场景灵活切换GPT或Llama等不同的大模型后端，实现跨平台的自动化助手解决方案。
agents_workflows.summary_en: AstrBot is an open-source agentic chatbot infrastructure that enables AI assistants to operate across multiple instant messaging platforms like Discord and Telegram. Its technical strength lies in modular architecture that cleanly separates platform adapters, LLM backends, and plugin systems, allowing developers to mix-and-match components. You can deploy it via Docker to create custom AI agents that respond to messages, execute tasks through plugins, and switch between different LLMs like GPT or Llama based on your needs.
